brand.name: JFR
brand.description: Not on the site at all - confirmed absent from the site's full 112-brand index. 'JFR' stands for 'Just For Retailers' - originally created to be sold only through brick-and-mortar retailers, no big-box/online-only distribution, which plausibly explains its absence from a general review-site index despite being well-documented by halfwheel, Cigar Coop, and Cigar Aficionado. Historically associated with Casa Fernandez (2013-2016 era sourcing); current (2025) sourcing attributes it to Aganorsa Leaf as a bestselling house brand. Both are Fernandez-family Nicaraguan tobacco operations; no source explicitly narrates the handoff between them, so that transition is noted as an inference, not a confirmed fact.

line.name: JFR 20th Anniversary
line.description: A regular-production line celebrating 20 years of the JFR brand (2005-2025), released by Aganorsa Leaf in 2025. Box-pressed, pigtail cap, covered foot, boxes of 21.
